title: Strict constant-complex pullback at all quotient levels
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $I$ an ideal such that $A_n=R/I^n$ is finite for every $n\ge1$, and $g:T'\to T$ any scheme morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], their geometric inverse image $g^{-1}$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], and constant sheaves $\underline N_W$ for scalar modules $N$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Put $B_W=\varprojlim_n\underline{A_n}_W$, with projections $\operatorname{pr}_{W,n}$ [def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit], for $W=T,T'$. For any cochain complex $P^\bullet$ of $R$-modules set $D_{W,n}^\bullet=\underline{A_n}_W\otimes_{\underline R_W}\underline{P^\bullet}_W$, with its given differential and consecutive transitions $q_{n+1,n}\otimes1$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Let $g_n^*$ be ordinary module pullback over the canonical constant-section coefficient isomorphism $g^{-1}\underline{A_n}_T\cong\underline{A_n}_{T'}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations].

There is a natural isomorphism of strict towers of complexes (with semilinear quotient transitions) [def-weil-inverse-system]
$$(g_n^*D_{T,n}^\bullet)_{n\ge1}\xrightarrow{\sim}(D_{T',n}^\bullet)_{n\ge1}.$$
Its level-$n$, degree-$r$ map is the canonical constant-module inverse-image comparison followed by the inverse-image tensor comparison, with constant sections sent by $a\otimes p\mapsto a\otimes p$. For any differential $d^r$, both composites send that section to $a\otimes d^rp$; for a consecutive quotient both composites send it to $q_{n+1,n}(a)\otimes p$. The same identities hold locally for sheaf tensor generators and so are equalities of chain and tower morphisms. The functor $g_n^*$ is exact because its coefficient map is an isomorphism, and this strict chain comparison represents the derived finite pullback comparison in the ambient module derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

These isomorphisms are natural in all scalar chain maps. In particular, for a bounded finite-projective $P^\bullet$ [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex] and $M_W^\bullet=B_W\otimes_{\underline R_W}\underline{P^\bullet}_W$, use the balanced finite-reduction maps $(b\otimes p)\otimes a\mapsto a\operatorname{pr}_{W,n}(b)\otimes p$. The induced reduction-tower maps commute with all consecutive transitions and normalized quotient units, including the unit $b\otimes p\mapsto(b\otimes p)\otimes1$. Regard each finite level as a $B_W$-module through $\operatorname{pr}_{W,n}$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. The induced map to the product of the reduction tower is annihilated by $1-s$, and hence its zero-shifted-component augmentation to the strict Roos cone $\operatorname{Cone}(1-s)[-1]$ is a chain map [def-sf-strict-roos-functor]. This compatibility includes the original scalar differentials and is independent of finite-free splittings. No isomorphism $g^{-1}B_T\cong B_{T'}$ is assumed.

proof.text: Apply normalized_reductions_exist separately on the source and target sites. Apply normalized_finite_pullback_exists to the two normalized finite towers, and normalized_completed_pullback_exists to their normalized reductions and finite comparison. Construct the Roos augmentation by mappingCocone.lift with product coordinate Pi.lift alpha and shifted coordinate zero: compatibility of alpha makes its product composite with 1-s zero; the cone projections and mapping-cone naturality give all four normalization clauses. Exactness of constant-ring pullback is already recorded and supplies the final additive, finite-limit and finite-colimit instances. FiniteComparison.derived retains the existing exact localization.

lean.statement:
theorem strict_constant_complex_base_change
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    (hfinite : ∀ n : ℕ, Finite (Quotient R I n))
    {T T' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ T) :
    ∃ (dT : FiniteTower T I) (dT' : FiniteTower T' I)
      (eT : ReductionData T I dT) (eT' : ReductionData T' I dT')
      (f : FiniteComparison g I dT dT'),
      dT.IsNormalized T I ∧ dT'.IsNormalized T' I ∧
      eT.IsNormalized T I ∧ eT'.IsNormalized T' I ∧ f.IsNormalized g I ∧
      (∃ a : RoosAugmentation T I eT, a.IsNormalized T I) ∧
      (∃ a : RoosAugmentation T' I eT', a.IsNormalized T' I) ∧
      (∃ e : GeometricReduction g I eT eT' f, e.IsNormalized g I) ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, (proEtaleConstantRingPullback (Quotient R I n) g).Additive ∧
        PreservesFiniteLimits (proEtaleConstantRingPullback (Quotient R I n) g) ∧
        PreservesFiniteColimits (proEtaleConstantRingPullback (Quotient R I n) g)
